name: A Vampy VN
source:
Play as Runa Heartwood, a witch who's intent on performing a ritual to resurrect her pet cat, and meet Jaspyn Starling, a vampire hoping to break a bloodthirsty curse.

[From [url=https://pixachar.itch.io/a-vampy-vn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演鲁娜·哈特伍德 (Runa Heartwood)，一名女巫，一心想举行仪式来复活她的宠物猫，并会见贾斯宾·斯塔林 (Jaspyn Starling)，一名希望打破嗜血诅咒的吸血鬼。

[来自[url=https://pixachar.itch.io/a-vampy-vn]itch.io[/url]]
